collection_id.description: The collection ID. Currently only accepts "default_collection".
collection_id.rationale: Identifier for the Discovery Engine collection. It does not configure access, encryption, networking, logging, or another security control.

control_id.description: The unique id of the control.
control_id.rationale: Identifier for the control resource. We do not constrain resource identifiers, so it is not a policy target.

deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.
deletion_policy.rationale: Controls protection against unintended deletion or abandonment of the resource. Policy should require an approved deletion setting, such as PREVENT, for production resources.

display_name.description:
The display name of the control. This field must be a UTF-8 encoded
string with a length limit of 128 characters.
display_name.rationale: Human-readable label used to identify the control. It does not change permissions, data protection, networking, or security behaviour.

engine_id.description: The engine to add the control to.
engine_id.rationale: Identifier referencing the engine the control belongs to. We do not constrain resource identifiers or references.

location.description:
The geographic location where the data store should reside. The value can
only be one of "global", "us" and "eu".
location.rationale: Determines the region/zone where the resource is created. Policy should restrict it to an approved-region whitelist for data residency; the allowed set is parameterised (a hardcoded example whitelist is acceptable).

project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: Identifier of the Google Cloud project containing the resource. Resource identifiers and references are not constrained by this policy framework.

solution_type.description: The solution type that the control belongs to. Possible values: ["SOLUTION_TYPE_RECOMMENDATION", "SOLUTION_TYPE_SEARCH", "SOLUTION_TYPE_CHAT", "SOLUTION_TYPE_GENERATIVE_CHAT"]
solution_type.rationale: Selects which Discovery Engine solution (search, recommendation, chat) the control applies to. This is a functional product configuration, not a security control.

use_cases.description: The use cases that the control is used for. Possible values: ["SEARCH_USE_CASE_SEARCH", "SEARCH_USE_CASE_BROWSE"]
use_cases.rationale: Selects the functional search or browse contexts in which the control operates. It does not configure a security boundary or access control.

boost_action.description: Changes the returned order of results.

boost_action.data_store.rationale: Identifier of the data store affected by the boost action. Resource references are not policy targets.

boost_action.filter.description: The filter to apply to the search results.
boost_action.filter.rationale: Defines which search results receive a relevance boost. It affects result ranking rather than authorization or access to the underlying data.

boost_action.fixed_boost.description: The fixed boost value to apply to the search results. Positive values will increase the relevance of the results, while negative values will decrease the relevance. The value must be between -100 and 100.
boost_action.fixed_boost.rationale: Adjusts the ranking score of matching search results. This is relevance configuration and does not establish a security control.

boost_action.interpolation_boost_spec.description: The interpolation boost specification to apply to the search results.

boost_action.interpolation_boost_spec.at.description: The attribute type to be used to determine the boost amount. Possible values: ["NUMERICAL", "FRESHNESS"]
boost_action.interpolation_boost_spec.at.rationale: Selects the attribute category used for relevance boosting. It does not affect authentication, authorization, encryption, or data access.

boost_action.interpolation_boost_spec.fi.description: The name of the field whose value will be used to determine the boost amount.
boost_action.interpolation_boost_spec.fi.rationale: Identifies a document field used to calculate search ranking. It does not grant access to the field or change a security boundary.

boost_action.interpolation_boost_spec.in.description: The interpolation type to be applied to connect the control points. Possible values: ["LINEAR"]
boost_action.interpolation_boost_spec.in.rationale: Defines the mathematical method used to calculate relevance boosts. It is not security-sensitive configuration.

boost_action.interpolation_boost_spec.co.description: The control points used to define the curve.
The attribute value of the control point.
boost_action.interpolation_boost_spec.co.rationale: Provides an input value for the relevance-boosting curve. It does not configure access or data protection.

boost_action.interpolation_boost_spec.co.description:
The value between -1 to 1 by which to boost the score if the attributeValue
evaluates to the value specified above.
boost_action.interpolation_boost_spec.co.rationale: Controls the amount by which a result ranking is adjusted. It affects search relevance only.

conditions.description: The conditions under which the control is active.

conditions.query_regex.description: The regular expression that the query must match for this condition to be met.
conditions.query_regex.rationale: Determines when the search control is activated based on query text. It does not provide authorization or protect the underlying data.

conditions.active_time_range.description: The time range when the condition is active.

conditions.active_time_range.end_time.description: The end time of the active time range.
conditions.active_time_range.end_time.rationale: Defines when the control stops being active. This is operational scheduling and not a security boundary.

conditions.active_time_range.start_time.description: The start time of the active time range.
conditions.active_time_range.start_time.rationale: Defines when the control becomes active. This is operational scheduling and not a security boundary.

conditions.query_terms.description: The query terms that must be present in the search request for this condition to be met.

conditions.query_terms.full_match.description: If true, the query term must be an exact match. Otherwise, the query term can be a partial match.
conditions.query_terms.full_match.rationale: Controls how query terms are matched when activating the control. It affects search behaviour rather than security.

conditions.query_terms.value.description: The value of the query term.
conditions.query_terms.value.rationale: Defines the query text that activates the control. It does not configure access to resources or data.

filter_action.data_store.rationale: Identifier of the data store affected by the filter action. Resource references are not constrained by policy.

filter_action.filter.description: The filter to apply to the search results.
filter_action.filter.rationale: Controls which entries are included in search results. Search filtering should not be treated as an authorization mechanism for the underlying data.

promote_action.description: Promotes a specified link for a query.

promote_action.data_store.rationale: Identifier of the data store used by the promotion. Resource references are not policy targets.

promote_action.search_link_promotion.description: The search link promotion to apply to the search results.

promote_action.search_link_promotion.des.description: The description of the promoted link.
promote_action.search_link_promotion.des.rationale: Human-readable descriptive content shown with the promoted link. It does not configure a security control.

promote_action.search_link_promotion.doc.rationale: Identifier of the document selected for promotion. Resource identifiers are not constrained by policy.

promote_action.search_link_promotion.ena.description: Return promotions for basic site search.
promote_action.search_link_promotion.ena.rationale: Enables or disables the search promotion feature. The promoted destinations are assessed separately through their URI fields.

promote_action.search_link_promotion.ima.description: The image URI of the promoted link.
promote_action.search_link_promotion.ima.rationale: Specifies a delivery URL for promoted image content. Policy should require the HTTPS scheme to protect data in transit; selecting a particular host or domain remains application-specific.

promote_action.search_link_promotion.tit.description: The title of the promoted link.
promote_action.search_link_promotion.tit.rationale: Human-readable title displayed for the promoted link. It does not itself determine the destination or establish a security control.

promote_action.search_link_promotion.uri.rationale: Specifies the destination URL presented through a promoted link. Policy should require the HTTPS scheme for secure transport without restricting application-specific destination hosts or domains.

redirect_action.redirect_uri.rationale: Specifies the endpoint to which matching users are redirected. Policy should require the HTTPS scheme for secure transport without restricting application-specific destination hosts or domains.

synonyms_action.synonyms.description: The synonyms to apply to the search results.
synonyms_action.synonyms.rationale: Defines equivalent search terms used to improve query matching. It affects search relevance rather than access control or data protection.
